title: Unified two-endpoint breeding distribution data bundle — draft v0.1
description: Schema only, no empirical rows. Traits and climate covariates are deliberately excluded until Step 2 definitions are frozen.

x-conventions.missing: JSON null; CSV empty cell; never encode missing/unobserved as 0. No NaN or Infinity in JSON.
x-conventions.time: breeding-season start year; actual synchronized endpoint dates
x-conventions.null: B=20000 independent draws per endpoint; p_pool=(n0+n1)/(N0+N1); uint32 seed = first 8 hex digits of SHA256(UTF-8("20261106|" + row_id)). Pair seed uses pair_row_id.
x-conventions.quantile: linear interpolation (Hyndman–Fan type 7); SD uses B-1 denominator; Monte Carlo SE = SD/sqrt(B)
x-conventions.cohort_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON array of sorted dataset-prefixed physical component IDs with compact separators, ensure_ascii=false
x-conventions.row_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON array [dataset_id, network_id, species_id, count_unit, cohort_id, year0, year1]; pending candidate key is recorded explicitly
x-conventions.pair_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON array [dataset_id, network_id, species_a, species_b, count_unit_a, count_unit_b, pair_cohort_id, year0, year1]; species_a/species_b sorted lexicographically
x-conventions.validation: Cross-column mathematical and lineage invariants below are checked in the builder; JSON Schema alone does not prove them.

x-cross-field-invariants: year1 > year0 and dt_years == year1 - year0 for synchronous estimable rows.
K == number of unique fixed component IDs, 0 <= occupied0,occupied1 <= K, N0,N1 are exact sums over the same K.
coverage_t == K/surveyed_components_t when the denominator is positive and known; never report as abundance coverage.
1 <= neff_t <= K for positive totals; raw and adjusted effects obey the formulas in STEP1_TABLE_SPEC.md.
Common count null requires synchronous epochs, K>=3, nonnegative integer-equivalent comparable counts, and N0,N1>=2.
Terminal-zero rows preserve N1=0 and interval_pct=-100 when N0>0; log change, raw concentration change and corrected concentration are null.
All corrected/null summary fields are null when null_status is not computed; their unavailability is not zero effect.
Model posterior means cannot be rounded into integer counts; no independent draws from marginal intervals.
extent_km requires comparable coordinates for every fixed component; no extent from island centroids for patch-level rows.
One original observation lineage cannot enter macro_primary multiple times via parent/child or repeated-window rows.
Pair rows require actual shared physical units at the same two epochs; per-species counts and total changes are recomputed on that pair cohort.
Both species in a pair require positive totals at both epochs and K_pair>=3 for corrected overlap; missing species records never become zero.
Endpoint registry lock and input hashes precede new common-effect computation; existing prior results remain disclosed.
No traits, climate associations, future projections or empirical row values are supplied by this schema.

For endpoint_registry.analysis_unit=network_species, species_id/count_unit are nonnull and pair-only species/unit fields are null; pair rows use species_a/species_b/count_unit_a/count_unit_b with species_id/count_unit null.

Pair endpoint choices are independent of single-species endpoint choices but use the same frozen input; species-pair MAPPPD earliest-start/latest-end selection uses both species at both endpoints and at least three verified physical units.
For a pair corrected null, all four species-by-endpoint totals must be >=2, not just the combined or single-species main-table totals.
An endpoint with a positive total retains its own neff even if the other endpoint is zero.
Three-year-window sensitivity is a separate prespecified output with nonoverlapping complete windows and elapsed mean observation years, never additional primary rows.

Q4 uncertainty must preserve shared source counts among species pairs within a network; global species membership effects plus a network intercept do not by themselves guarantee independent pair residuals.

network_species.description: One source × network × species × unit × fixed cohort × endpoint pair, including explicit non-estimation candidates.

row_id.description: Deterministic SHA-256 ID of dataset, network, species, count unit, cohort and endpoint pair; pending rows use candidate key.

dataset_id.description: Stable input family; source effects use the family, not each file or island.

network_id.description: Dataset-prefixed original network identity; species is not part of this identity.

species_id.description: Harmonized taxon ID; original spelling remains in unit_endpoints and source catalog.

cohort_id.description: SHA-256 of the sorted, dataset-prefixed fixed physical component IDs.

component_type.description: Original breeding component type, not assumed equivalent across source families.

parent_network_id.description: Known enclosing network; null if not applicable or unresolved.

lineage_group.description: Shared original observation lineage, used to prevent pseudoreplication.

year0.description: Earlier synchronous census / breeding-season start year; null for non-synchronous or unavailable endpoint.

year1.description: Later synchronous census / breeding-season start year; never shifted to retain positive counts.

dt_years.description: year1 - year0; strictly positive if known.

epoch_sync_status.description: Whether all retained units share the same early and late census years.

K.description: Fixed cohort size at both endpoints, including explicitly observed zero-count components.

occupied0.description: Number of fixed-cohort components with a strictly positive early count.

occupied1.description: Number of fixed-cohort components with a strictly positive late count.

surveyed_components0.description: All comparable recorded components in the early original network census, not just the matched intersection.

surveyed_components1.description: All comparable recorded components in the late original network census.

coverage0.description: K / surveyed_components0; surveyed-component coverage, not population coverage.

coverage1.description: K / surveyed_components1; surveyed-component coverage, not population coverage.

N0.description: Sum of early values over exactly the fixed cohort in its original count unit.

N1.description: Sum of late values over exactly the fixed cohort in its original count unit.

count_unit.description: Unconverted original unit: AON, AOS, AOT, AOB, IND, nest, breeding_pair, adult_index, or documented source-specific equivalent.

estimate_type.description: Observation status; adjusted counts are not an observation-error-calibrated census.

neff0.description: D2_0 = 1 / sum((n_j0/N0)^2). Null if N0 is zero or source is unavailable.

neff1.description: D2_1 = 1 / sum((n_j1/N1)^2). Null if N1 is zero or source is unavailable.

concentration_raw_decade.description: Y_raw = -10/(year1-year0) * log(neff1/neff0); positive means increasing concentration.

concentration_excess_decade.description: Y_raw - mean(Y_null); common two-end fixed-share count benchmark. Never replace unavailable model uncertainty by zero.

null_mean_decade.description: Monte Carlo mean under the paired common-share multinomial benchmark.

null_sd_decade.description: SD of simulated null outcomes, not the SE of the observed effect.

null_q025_decade.description: 2.5th percentile of null outcomes, not an observed-effect confidence limit.

null_q975_decade.description: 97.5th percentile of null outcomes, not an observed-effect confidence limit.

null_mcse_decade.description: Monte Carlo SE of the estimated null mean, SD/sqrt(B), not observation uncertainty.

null_status.description: Why the common null is computed or unavailable.

abundance_log_change_decade.description: G = 10/(year1-year0) * log(N1/N0), defined only for positive endpoint totals.

abundance_pct_change_decade.description: 100*(exp(G)-1); null when either endpoint total is zero.

abundance_pct_change_interval.description: 100*(N1/N0-1), defined when N0>0; equals -100 for terminal zero.

extent_km.description: Maximum pairwise WGS84 geodesic distance across all fixed-cohort components, including zeros; null if any comparable coordinates missing.

endpoint_status.description: Endpoint outcome / support state, without dropping zero totals.

analysis_role.description: Mutually exclusive use in the current unified design.

exclusion_reason.description: Machine-readable reasons for no primary count inference, including outcome-specific or covariate-specific missingness.

prior_view_status.description: Whether previous outcomes from this source had already been viewed.

unit_endpoints.description: Original source rows on the two frozen endpoints, with explicit survey/missingness semantics.

row_id.description: Parent network_species.row_id or network_species_pairs.pair_row_id, distinguished by analysis_unit; source lineage retained across cohorts.

raw_species_label.description: Original source spelling, including Razorbil if present.

physical_unit_id.description: Verified physical-unit ID for cross-species overlap; null if source species labels do not establish common physical support.

year.description: Actual component census / breeding-season start year.

raw_season_label.description: Original year or season text before harmonization.

count_value.description: Unrounded recorded value; explicit observed zero retained; null for missing or unobserved species.

raw_value.description: Original source cell representation for exact reconstruction.

estimate_type.description: Observation status; adjusted counts are not an observation-error-calibrated census.

method.description: Original method label; null when absent from saved source.

latitude.description: Original comparable component latitude in degrees.

longitude.description: Original comparable component longitude in degrees.

coordinate_semantics.description: e.g. original_start_point, colony_point, monitoring_patch; null if unavailable.

source_record_id.description: Original observation ID if present; do not invent absent IDs.

source_row_locator.description: Exact file/sheet/row or stable keyed locator in the fixed source.

lineage_group.description: Shared original observation identity / family for duplicate detection.

analysis_unit.description: Whether row_id references a species row or an independently frozen species-pair row.

network_species_pairs.description: Unordered species pairs on verified common physical support; not inferred from aggregate totals.

pair_row_id.description: Deterministic network, unordered species pair, unit pair, cohort and endpoint key.

species_a.description: Lexicographically first harmonized species ID; labels have no distinct random-effect roles.

species_b.description: Second species ID; must differ from species_a.

pair_cohort_id.description: SHA-256 of verified shared physical components observed for BOTH species at BOTH endpoints.

year0.description: Earlier synchronous census / breeding-season start year; null for non-synchronous or unavailable endpoint.

year1.description: Later synchronous census / breeding-season start year; never shifted to retain positive counts.

dt_years.description: year1 - year0; strictly positive if known.

K_pair.description: Fixed physical units common to both species and both epochs.

count_unit_b.description: Original species-b count unit; no adding unlike units.

N_a0.description: Early species-a total recomputed on pair cohort.

N_a1.description: Late species-a total recomputed on pair cohort.

N_b0.description: Early species-b total recomputed on pair cohort.

N_b1.description: Late species-b total recomputed on pair cohort.

G_a_decade.description: Species-a log total change recomputed on pair cohort.

G_b_decade.description: Species-b log total change recomputed on pair cohort.

pair_decline_decade.description: -(G_a_decade+G_b_decade)/2; positive is greater mean proportional decline, without summing unlike count units.

overlap_excess_decade.description: Raw overlap change minus the mean of the independent species-specific common-share count benchmark.

null_mean_decade.description: Mean simulated overlap change; not observed-effect uncertainty.

null_sd_decade.description: SD of simulated overlap changes, not an observed-effect SE.

null_mcse_decade.description: Monte Carlo error of the null mean only.

null_status.description: Why the common null is computed or unavailable.

extent_km.description: WGS84 diameter of the fixed pair cohort, not copied from a different species cohort.

analysis_role.description: Mutually exclusive use in the current unified design.

exclusion_reason.description: All non-estimation / non-primary reasons; absent common physical support does not mean zero overlap.

endpoint_registry.description: Availability-only single-species and species-pair endpoint/roster choices; each locked before its new common metrics.

candidate_id.description: Stable source/network/taxon-or-unordered-pair/original-unit availability-audit key; independent of ecological effect values.

row_id.description: Output row_id or pair_row_id according to analysis_unit; null until the endpoint/cohort choice is resolved.

species_id.description: Harmonized single-species ID; null for a species-pair registry row.

count_unit.description: Single-species source unit; null for a pair, whose two units are recorded separately.

year0.description: Earlier synchronous census / breeding-season start year; null for non-synchronous or unavailable endpoint.

year1.description: Later synchronous census / breeding-season start year; never shifted to retain positive counts.

component_ids.description: Sorted fixed physical components; empty only when unresolved or none.

cohort_id.description: SHA-256 of the sorted, dataset-prefixed fixed physical component IDs.

epoch_sync_status.description: Whether all retained units share the same early and late census years.

candidate_pair_count.description: Number of availability/method-compatible candidate epoch pairs, if applicable.

selection_basis.description: Outcome-blind variables for NEW endpoint selection.

selection_status.description: Registry must be locked before new common metric computation.

non_estimation_reasons.description: Non-selection reasons retained for every candidate.

source_ids.description: Source catalog IDs used for endpoint choice.

locked_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 lock time; null while this document is a draft.

analysis_unit.description: Which output table this endpoint/cohort lock supports.

species_a.description: First lexicographically sorted pair species; null for a single-species registry row.

species_b.description: Second pair species; null for a single-species registry row.

count_unit_a.description: Original first-species count unit for pair rows; null for single-species rows.

count_unit_b.description: Original second-species count unit for pair rows; null for single-species rows.
